indicators: DNS A record for example.com resolved to 10.10.10.50 (unexpected internal IP)
DNS responses from internal resolver (192.168.1.1) with suspicious IPs
Mismatch between authoritative DNS server IP and client resolver IP
Browser HTTP Host header matches legit domain but IP is non-standard
Absence of DNSSEC validation or RRSIG records for example.com
Logs showing DNS query responses with forged IPs
examples.detection_method: Monitor DNS traffic for anomalous IP responses, validate DNSSEC signatures on DNS replies, alert on DNS responses containing unexpected IP addresses for sensitive domains, correlate HTTP Host headers with resolved IPs, deploy internal DNS auditing tools to detect rogue or unauthorized DNS servers.
